items.source: The key thing to understand here is that the client code inside the main(..) method of the Main class has a reference to the proxy. This means that method calls on that object reference are calls on the proxy. As a result, the proxy can delegate to all of the interceptors (advice) that are relevant to that particular method call. However, once the call has finally reached the target object (the SimplePojo reference in this case), any method calls that it may make on itself, such as this.bar() or this.foo(), are going to be invoked against the this reference, and not the proxy. This has important implications. It means that self invocation is not going to result in the advice associated with a method invocation getting a chance to run. In other words, self invocation via an explicit or implicit this reference will bypass the advice.
items.translation: 这里需要理解的关键点是，Main 类中 main(..) 方法内的客户端代码持有代理的引用。这意味着对该对象引用的方法调用实际上是针对代理的调用。因此，代理可以委托给与该特定方法调用相关的所有拦截器（通知）。然而，一旦调用最终到达目标对象（在本例中为 SimplePojo 引用），它可能在其自身上执行的任何方法调用，例如 this.bar() 或 this.foo()，都将针对 this 引用进行调用，而不是代理。这具有重要的影响。这意味着自调用不会导致与方法调用相关的通知有机会执行。换句话说，通过显式或隐式的 this 引用进行的自调用将绕过通知。

items.source: As of 7.0, forcing a specific proxy type for individual beans is possible through the @Proxyable annotation on a given @Bean method or @Component class, with @Proxyable(INTERFACES) or @Proxyable(TARGET_CLASS) overriding any globally configured default. For very specific purposes, you may even specify the proxy interface(s) to use through @Proxyable(interfaces=…​), limiting the exposure to selected interfaces rather than all interfaces that the target bean implements.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，可以通过在特定的@Bean方法或@Component类上使用@Proxyable注解来强制指定单个 Bean 的代理类型，其中@Proxyable(INTERFACES)或@Proxyable(TARGET_CLASS)将覆盖任何全局配置的默认设置。对于非常特定的用途，您甚至可以通过@Proxyable(interfaces=…​)指定要使用的代理接口，从而将暴露范围限制为选定的接口，而不是目标 Bean 实现的所有接口。

items.source: Multiple <aop:config/> sections are collapsed into a single unified auto-proxy creator at runtime, which applies the strongest proxy settings that any of the <aop:config/> sections (typically from different XML bean definition files) specified. This also applies to the <tx:annotation-driven/> and <aop:aspectj-autoproxy/> elements.
items.translation: 运行时，多个<aop:config/>部分会被合并为一个统一的自动代理创建器，该创建器应用所有指定的<aop:config/>部分（通常来自不同的 XML bean 定义文件）中最强的代理设置。这也适用于<tx:annotation-driven/>和<aop:aspectj-autoproxy/>元素。

items.source: To be clear, using proxy-target-class="true" on <tx:annotation-driven/>, <aop:aspectj-autoproxy/>, or <aop:config/> elements forces the use of CGLIB proxies for all three of them.
items.translation: 为明确起见，在 ``、`` 或 `` 元素上使用 `proxy-target-class="true"` 会强制对这三者全部使用 CGLIB 代理。

items.source: @EnableAspectJAutoProxy, @EnableTransactionManagement and related configuration annotations offer a corresponding proxyTargetClass attribute. These are collapsed into a single unified auto-proxy creator too, effectively applying the strongest proxy settings at runtime. As of 7.0, this applies to individual proxy processors as well, for example @EnableAsync, consistently participating in unified global default settings for all auto-proxying attempts in a given application.
items.translation: @EnableAspectJAutoProxy、@EnableTransactionManagement 及相关配置注解提供了对应的 proxyTargetClass 属性。这些属性被合并为一个统一的自动代理创建器，从而在运行时有效地应用最强的代理设置。自 7.0 版本起，这也适用于各个单独的代理处理器，例如 @EnableAsync，它们始终参与给定应用程序中所有自动代理尝试的统一全局默认设置。

items.source: To force CGLIB proxying when you use the @AspectJ auto-proxy support, set the proxy-target-class attribute of the <aop:aspectj-autoproxy> element to true, as follows:
items.translation: 要在使用@AspectJ自动代理支持时强制使用CGLIB代理，请将<aop:aspectj-autoproxy>元素的proxy-target-class属性设置为true，如下所示：

items.source: Your CGLIB proxy usage may face limitations with the Java Module System. As a typical case, you cannot create a CGLIB proxy for a class from the java.lang package when deploying on the module path. Such cases require a JVM bootstrap flag --add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED which is not available for modules.
items.translation: 您的 CGLIB 代理使用可能会受到 Java 模块系统的限制。作为一个典型情况，在模块路径上部署时，您无法为 java.lang 包中的类创建 CGLIB 代理。此类情况需要 JVM 引导标志 --add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED，但该标志不适用于模块。

items.source: To force the use of CGLIB proxies, set the value of the proxy-target-class attribute of the <aop:config> element to true, as follows:
items.translation: 要强制使用 CGLIB 代理，请将 <aop:config> 元素的 proxy-target-class 属性值设置为 true，如下所示：

items.source: An alternative approach is to make use of self injection, and invoke methods on the proxy via the self reference instead of via this.
items.translation: 另一种方法是利用自注入，并通过自引用而非this调用代理上的方法。

items.source: The use of AopContext.currentProxy() totally couples your code to Spring AOP, and it makes the class itself aware of the fact that it is being used in an AOP context, which reduces some of the benefits of AOP. It also requires that the ProxyFactory is configured to expose the proxy, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 使用AopContext.currentProxy()会使您的代码完全耦合到 Spring AOP，并使类本身意识到它正在 AOP 上下文中被使用，从而减少了 AOP 的一些优势。此外，它还要求将ProxyFactory配置为暴露代理，如下例所示：

items.source: Spring AOP uses either JDK dynamic proxies or CGLIB to create the proxy for a given target object. JDK dynamic proxies are built into the JDK, whereas CGLIB is a common open-source class definition library (repackaged into spring-core).
items.translation: Spring AOP 使用 JDK 动态代理或 CGLIB 为给定的目标对象创建代理。JDK 动态代理内置于 JDK 中，而 CGLIB 是一个常见的开源类定义库（重新打包到 spring-core 中）。

items.source: final classes cannot be proxied, because they cannot be extended.
items.translation: final 类无法被代理，因为它们不能被扩展。

items.source: final methods cannot be advised, because they cannot be overridden.
items.translation: final 方法无法进行增强，因为它们不能被重写。

items.source: private methods cannot be advised, because they cannot be overridden.
items.translation: private 方法无法进行增强，因为它们不能被重写。

items.source:
If the target object to be proxied implements at least one interface, a JDK dynamic
proxy is used, and all of the interfaces implemented by the target type are proxied.
If the target object does not implement any interfaces, a CGLIB proxy is created which
is a runtime-generated subclass of the target type.
items.translation: 如果被代理的目标对象实现了至少一个接口，则使用 JDK 动态代理，并且为目标类型实现的所有接口创建代理。如果目标对象未实现任何接口，则创建一个 CGLIB 代理，它是目标类型的运行时生成的子类。

items.source:
If you want to force the use of CGLIB proxying (for example, to proxy every method
defined for the target object, not only those implemented by its interfaces),
you can do so. However, you should consider the following issues:
items.translation: 如果您想强制使用 CGLIB 代理（例如，为目标对象定义的每个方法生成代理，而不仅仅是其接口中实现的方法），您可以这样做。但是，您应该考虑以下问题：

items.source:
Methods that are not visible – for example, package-private methods in a parent class
from a different package – cannot be advised because they are effectively private.
items.translation: 不可见的方法（例如来自不同包中的父类中的包私有方法）无法进行增强，因为它们实际上等同于私有。

items.source:
The constructor of your proxied object will not be called twice, since the CGLIB proxy
instance is created through Objenesis. However, if your JVM does not allow for
constructor bypassing, you might see double invocations and corresponding debug log
entries from Spring’s AOP support.
items.translation: 您的代理对象的构造函数不会被调用两次，因为 CGLIB 代理实例是通过 Objenesis 创建的。但是，如果您的 JVM 不允许绕过构造函数，您可能会看到双重调用以及来自 Spring AOP 支持的相关调试日志条目。

items.source:
The global default proxy type may differ between setups. While the core framework
suggests interface-based proxies by default, Spring Boot may - depending on
configuration properties - enable class-based proxies by default.
items.translation: 全局默认代理类型可能因环境而异。虽然核心框架默认建议使用基于接口的代理，但 Spring Boot 可能会根据配置属性默认启用基于类的代理。

items.source:
Spring AOP is proxy-based. It is vitally important that you grasp the semantics of
what that last statement actually means before you write your own aspects or use any of
the Spring AOP-based aspects supplied with the Spring Framework.
items.translation: Spring AOP 基于代理。在编写自己的切面或使用 Spring 框架提供的任何基于 Spring AOP 的切面之前，您必须深刻理解最后一句话的实际含义，这一点至关重要。

items.source:
Consider first the scenario where you have a plain-vanilla, un-proxied object reference,
as the following code snippet shows:
items.translation: 首先考虑您拥有一个普通、未代理的对象引用的情况，如下所示的代码片段：

items.source:
If you invoke a method on an object reference, the method is invoked directly on
that object reference, as the following image and listing show:
items.translation: 如果在对象引用上调用方法，该方法将直接在该对象引用上被调用，如下面的图像和列表所示：

items.source:
Things change slightly when the reference that client code has is a proxy. Consider the
following diagram and code snippet:
items.translation: 当客户端代码持有的引用是代理时，情况会有所不同。考虑以下图表和代码片段：

items.source: To address that, you have the following options.
items.translation: 为了解决这个问题，您有以下选项。

items.source:
The best approach (the term "best" is used loosely here) is to refactor your code such
that the self invocation does not happen. This does entail some work on your part, but
it is the best, least-invasive approach.
items.translation: 最佳方法（此处“最佳”一词使用较为宽松）是重构您的代码，以避免发生自调用。这确实需要您付出一些努力，但这是影响最小的最佳方案。

items.source:
This last approach is highly discouraged, and we hesitate to point it out, in favor of
the previous options. However, as a last resort you can choose to tie the logic within
your class to Spring AOP, as the following example shows.
items.translation: 这种最后的方法极不推荐，我们宁愿建议采用前面的选项而不愿提及它。然而，作为最后的补救措施，您可以选择将类中的逻辑与 Spring AOP 绑定，如下例所示。
